0.translation: Compare arrow outlines on the same observed CDS. Choose shape before size; neither changes the interval, strand or biological function.

1.translation: ## Prepare a real annotation and local window ⟦shared:0⟧

2.translation: Use the bundled integrase in ⟦shared:0⟧: OQ646790.1 at 43,765–46,140 bp. Restore the original positive strand from ⟦shared:1⟧. Focus on 43,000–47,000 bp for visibility and display source coordinates on the axis.

4.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ retains clipping and source metadata. Your CDS needs a complete sequence length, matching ⟦shared:1⟧, one-based inclusive ⟦shared:2⟧, and an evidence-backed strand. Use ⟦shared:3⟧ for unknown strands. This page runs independently in a new R session and requires the optional dplyr package.

5.translation: ## Select the real neighbourhood by explicit ID ⟦shared:0⟧

6.translation: Combine source accession/endpoints into a workflow target ID, not a claimed database gene ID. Find_ggchord_loci selects exact IDs and extends 100 bp upstream/downstream in biological direction. Negative-strand upstream points to larger source coordinates; unknown/bidirectional strands require symmetric extensions. Pass returned windows to focus_ggchord_data and inspect full-length boundary clipping flags.

10.translation: All figures use 9 × 4 inches and identical input, window and layers. To expose shoulders, all three explicitly use ⟦shared:0⟧ (default 1). Only ⟦shared:1⟧ changes.

13.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ is the default construction. A wider head creates shoulders where it joins the shaft, emphasizing direction.

16.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ uses a flush head-to-shaft outline. Compare the head junction while keeping the same endpoints and shaft.

19.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ draws the entire interval as a triangular wedge rather than adding a head to a rectangular shaft. Shape differences do not imply different functions or measured values.

20.translation: ## When a short feature cannot fit its head ⟦shared:0⟧

21.translation: Keep the same observed integrase and window, requesting head length 1.5 in all three plots so the interval is short relative to its head. Change only short_feature: auto chooses a compressed directional glyph, wedge a wedge, block an undirected block. Do not lengthen source coordinates to fit a head; a block does not make the biological strand unknown.

31.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧, resolving to 0.05 | Shaft width; may vary by sequence or strand |

32.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Head length in the local frame, not bp |

33.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Head width relative to the shaft; 1.6 in all three figures |

35.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Selects wedge or block when the head cannot fit; explicit wedge/block fixes the fallback |

36.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | position_strand separates strands; position_feature_stack separates overlaps |

37.translation: Do not hide short intervals by enlarging heads. Check source length before choosing a fallback. Generic ⟦shared:0⟧ accepts fixed ⟦shared:1⟧ or mapped ⟦shared:2⟧ with a corresponding scale; see [styling](⟦shared:3⟧).

38.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ is a preset with different width, head dimensions and Position defaults. Changing several defaults while comparing it to gene is not a single-parameter experiment. Segmented annotation boundaries mark segments, not different genes.

39.translation: ## Modes, input adaptation and next steps ⟦shared:0⟧

40.translation: Gene arrows support bp inputs in chord, collinear and single circular modes. Use generic features for aa intervals. Focusing and display reversal do not rewrite biological strand; see [compatibility](⟦shared:0⟧).

41.translation: First change the common head width from 1.6 back to 1 and inspect shoulder visibility. Then change only ⟦shared:0⟧ and compare shaft versus backbone width. Keep export dimensions fixed rather than editing source intervals to improve appearance.

42.translation: Continue with [feature stacking](⟦shared:0⟧), [labels](⟦shared:1⟧), or add this CDS to the [four-genome example](⟦shared:2⟧). Full interfaces: [⟦shared:3⟧](⟦shared:4⟧), [⟦shared:5⟧](⟦shared:6⟧).
